# Filter and analyse

#Import the rds file

```{r}
#Import the libraries
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
# Import the rds file
#seurat_object <- readRDS("data/big_data/RDS_files/SeuratObject_All_Metadata.rds")
seurat_object <- readRDS("data/big_data/RDS_files/Seurat_Object_filtered-CDS_Metadata.rds")
# Show the first 6 rows of the object
head(seurat_object)
#show the number of cells
ncol(seurat_object)
#show the number of genes
nrow(seurat_object)

```

#Filter the cells

```{r}
#Filter the cells with less than 200 counts
seurat_object_filtered <- subset(seurat_object, subset = nCount_RNA > 0)
#Show the number of cells after filtering
ncol(seurat_object_filtered)

#show the max and min of the counts
max(seurat_object_filtered$nCount_RNA)
min(seurat_object_filtered$nCount_RNA)
mean(seurat_object_filtered$nCount_RNA)
median(seurat_object_filtered$nCount_RNA)

#show the max and min of the genes
max(seurat_object_filtered$nFeature_RNA)
min(seurat_object_filtered$nFeature_RNA)

```

```{r}
seurat_object_filtered
str(seurat_object_filtered)
head(seurat_object_filtered)

```

```{r}
VlnPlot(seurat_object_filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), ncol = 2, pt.size = 0.1, group.by = "Condition") #group by the Condition

# group by condition and OD_timepoint
VlnPlot(seurat_object_filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), ncol = 2, pt.size = 0.1, group.by = c("Condition"), split.by = "OD_timepoint") #split by the OD_timepoint and group by the Condition , add legend

```

```{r}

VlnPlot(object = seurat_object, 
  features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"),
        group.by = "Condition", 
        split.by = "OD_timepoint", 
        pt.size = 0.5, 
        combine = FALSE ,
        fill.by = "Condition")

```

```{r}
VlnPlot(object = seurat_object_filtered, 
  features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"),
        group.by = "Condition", 
        split.by = "OD_timepoint", 
        pt.size = 0.5, 
        combine = FALSE ,
        fill.by = "Condition")
```

```{r}

plot_feature_scatter <- FeatureScatter(seurat_object, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA",  group.by = "Condition")
plot_feature_scatter

```
